name: Tm Visualization Suite: Temporal Patterns
pitch: Find daily, weekly, and yearly patterns in Qlik time data with six chart types.
question: How do values change over time, and which daily or seasonal pattern repeats?
useWhen: Find a daily, weekly, or seasonal pattern in time data.
features: Draw daily values as a calendar heatmap with weekday patterns and gaps.
Compare the shape of one time series across many categories in a ridgeline.
Fold a long time series into magnitude bands in a compact horizon chart.
Compare the same period across years with a cycle plot.
Split a total into stacked series with a streamgraph.
Read many repeating periods in a seasonal heatmap.

hero.alt: Calendar heatmap of daily net sales for nine regions, with one cell for each trading day.

screenshots.alt: Ridgeline chart with one ridge for each of nine regions across three years of daily sales.
screenshots.caption: Compare the shape of each region on one time axis.

screenshots.alt: Streamgraph of quarterly net sales split by department, stacked as layers over time.
screenshots.caption: See how a total splits into parts over time.
